title: Law to require free abortion pills at all city sexual health clinics
summary: This bill would require the city's Department of Health and Mental Hygiene to offer free medication abortion at every health clinic it runs that offers sexual health services, not just the four clinics that currently do so. Currently DOHMH provides this medication at the Fort Greene, Jamaica, Morrisania and Central Harlem clinics, which together served 1,253 abortion patients in 2025. The law would take effect immediately upon passage.
